description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition, a component responsible for rendering CSS property definitions into HTML format within the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_CSSDefinition
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering CSS property definitions as HTML tables within the HTMLPurifier library.
